result.rationale: The diff shows `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` in EmbeddableHost.record_for_host, lowercasing only the stored column while comparing the referer's uri.host as-is; a mixed-case referer host would fail the equality and be rejected, whereas the old code compared against split strings without case normalization either. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff, though browsers typically send lowercase hostnames, so real-world impact is limited.

judged_text: app/models/embeddable_host.rb:17 — `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` lowercases only the column while `uri.host` from the referer is compared as-is, so a referer such as `http://EvilTrout.com/page` (mixed-case Host header/referer) fails `host_allowed?` and the embed is rejected with InvalidAccess (severity P3, confidence 75, advisory; rebuttal: browsers normally send lowercase hostnames in Referer — survives because URI() does not normalize case and hand-built referers exist)
